raw_source.text_snippet: The marked enrichment of triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) among PV/LPV carriers in our cohort (43.3% vs. 8.5% in non-carriers; OR = 8.24, 95% CI: 3.87–17.55; p < 0.0001) is consistent with the established biological profile of BRCA1 -associated tumors and reflects defects in homologous recombination pathway leading to a basal-like phenotype. This is further supported by significantly reduced hormone receptor expression (median ER 1% vs. 100%, PR 0% vs. 70%; both p < 0.0001) and higher proliferative activity (Ki-67: 30% vs. 20%, p < 0.001) in carriers. Clinically, carriers also presented with larger tumors (27.5 mm vs. 18.0 mm, p = 0.013) and more advanced disease (stage IIIA–IV: 20.0% vs. ~ 10.0%, p < 0.001),
